confidence: high; absence of feature is informative because UniProt annotates TM features for this proteome

finding: max KD(19) = 0.15 (threshold 1.6); max GES transfer energy over 19-aa window = -4.4 kcal/mol (insertion needs ~ +20); GRAVY = -1.52; 0 TM windows

finding: 159 canonical-size orthologs (160-230 aa): 0 UniProt TRANSMEM features, 1 KD TM window, GRAVY mean -1.34 (sd 0.18), mean charged (DEKR) fraction 0.366

finding: mean pLDDT 63.9, median 61.3; 72.5% of residues below pLDDT 70; 0 HELIX/SHEET records; no folded core and no hydrophobic helix of TM length

claim: LNP1 has a cleavable signal peptide or organelle targeting signal
finding: N-terminus MEHKDDDDDD: first 30 aa net charge -7 with 10 acidic residues (mito presequences are Arg-rich, acid-free); max KD over 7-aa windows in residues 1-30 = 0.73 (SP h-region needs >2.0); no KDEL/HDEL, no KKXX, no CaaX, no N-myristoylation Gly2, no C-terminal GPI signal (max KD -0.85)

claim: The 'membrane protein with 2 TM helices' idea belongs to LNP1
finding: HGNC lists 'LNP1' as an alias of LNPK (lunapark, ER junction formation factor, 2q31.1, Q9C0E8). LNP1 proper is HGNC:28014 at 3q12.2 (A1A4G5). UniProt Q9C0E8 is annotated with TM 46-66 and TM 78-98, Ncyt/Ccyt, N-myristoyl Gly2.
confidence: high; this is the most likely origin of the seed hypothesis

claim: LNP1 resides in a membrane compartment
finding: HPA antibody IF for LNP1/A1A4G5: main location Vesicles; additional Nuclear speckles and Cytosol; reliability 'Approved'. LNPK by contrast: main location Endoplasmic reticulum.
confidence: moderate; single-antibody IF, 'Approved' not 'Enhanced'; punctate cytoplasmic staining does not establish integral membrane insertion
